howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Select a text-based or scanned PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose extraction mode
howto.text: Select plain text extraction for text-based PDFs, or enable OCR for scanned documents. Pick the OCR language if needed.

howto.name: Download the text
howto.text: Click Convert. The extracted text is returned as a .txt file with page breaks preserved.

faq.q: Is formatting preserved in the text output?
faq.a: The tool extracts raw text only. Bold, italic, font sizes, and layout are not preserved — you get clean plain text.

faq.q: Can I extract text from a specific page range?
faq.a: Yes. Specify page numbers or ranges to extract text from only the pages you need.

faq.q: How does it handle multi-column layouts?
faq.a: The tool reads text in natural reading order. Two-column layouts are generally handled correctly, but complex magazine-style layouts may interleave columns.
